# WebM File

## Summary
The video specialization for WebM.
An instance is an uploaded realm file with card semantics: the binary lives at
the file URL while the card carries extracted metadata and renders with
format-aware templates.

## Shape
Extends `VideoDef`. Adds no fields of its own — `duration`, `width`, `height` and `encoding` come from
`VideoDef`. It supplies its own extraction pass because WebM is Matroska/EBML,
not an ISO base-media container: duration and track geometry are read from EBML
elements, so none of the MP4 box-tree walk applies.

Accepts: `.webm, video/webm`

## Example
```ts
import { WebmDef } from 'https://cardstack.com/base/webm-video-def';

@field attachment = linksTo(WebmDef);
```
Instances are created by upload (`createFileDef` wires the type from the
MIME type). Live examples need uploaded fixtures — `Spec` has no field that
accepts a file today (`linkedExamples` is `linksToMany(CardDef)`, and
`FileDef` is a sibling of `CardDef`), so the example check stays open for
every file def until `fileExamples` lands.
